import html # Define a simple template for rendering blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user-generated blog post safely for HTML output. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully sanitized HTML string ready for safe display. Notes ----- - The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize any HTML special characters that could otherwise lead to XSS or injection attacks. - The template is a simple string with `{title}` and `{body}` placeholders which are replaced after escaping, preventing any template injection. """ # Sanitize user input safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Render the final HTML using the template rendered_html = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered_html
